b1-unit-36.36.1 Planning a long weekend:
Danny: So where shall we go for the long weekend? I really need some time off after all those tours.
Bruno: Why don't we go to Rio? I haven't been there in years, and you've never been, right?
Danny: Right. But I'm not sure about that, to be honest. Mrs. Lima says it gets really crowded on long weekends, and it's a bit touristy for me. Where else do you have in mind?
Bruno: Hmm... What about Paraty? I went there with my parents when I was a kid. The old town was stunning, and the atmosphere at night was really lively.
Danny: That sounds like a good idea! Shall we ask Rafa to come along? He's always talking about the beaches down there.
Bruno: Sure. He just needs to check if he can take Monday off. I think he has a tour that morning.
Danny: OK. What about accommodation? How about a hotel in the old town?
Bruno: You must be joking! Hotels are expensive on a long weekend. I suggest we stay at a hostel. It's cheaper, and you meet lots of people.
Danny: I suppose we could do that... but I already live in a hostel, you know!
Bruno: Ha! Fair point. Then why don't we rent a small house with Rafa? If we share the cost, it might be worth it.
Danny: Right, that makes sense. And the bus?
Bruno: I'd suggest booking the tickets as soon as possible to get a good deal. Long weekends sell out fast.
Danny: Good idea. I'll get online right away.
